北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京 35℃，多云但体感 37℃，出门别忘防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is 35℃, feels like 37℃ with clouds. Don't forget sunscreen and hydration!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴热 35℃，风力不小，注意防晒，及时补充水分！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and hot at 35℃, with strong winds. Protect from sun and hydrate!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海 35℃，体感 37℃，阳光正烈，小心中暑，记得多喝水。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is 35℃, feels like 37℃. Intense sun, stay hydrated to avoid heatstroke.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州 28℃，体感 30℃，湿度大，记得防潮，保持身体舒适。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is 28℃, feels like 30℃ with high humidity. Stay comfortable and dry.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳 28℃，体感 31℃，湿度偏高，注意防潮，保持清爽哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is 28℃, feels like 31℃ with high humidity. Stay fresh and mind the damp.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州 35℃，体感 37℃，闷热。请及时补水，避免长时间户外活动。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is 35℃, feels like 37℃, quite muggy. Hydrate and limit outdoor time.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京 35℃，体感 37℃，阴天也热。注意防暑降温，照顾好自己。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is 35℃, feels like 37℃, hot even with cloud. Stay cool and take care!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗 34℃，体感 35℃。阳光充足，记得补水防晒！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny 34℃, feels like 35℃. Plenty of sun, hydrate and use sunscreen!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉 36℃，体感也 36℃，阴天也很热！小心中暑，多补充水分。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is 36℃, feels like 36℃, hot even with cloud! Watch for heatstroke, hydrate.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阵雨 22℃，体感 23℃，湿度较高。出门别忘带伞，注意防潮。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an has showers, 22℃, feels like 23℃, high humidity. Take an umbrella, mind the damp.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆 24℃，体感 27℃，湿度非常大。注意防潮，保持室内通风。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is 24℃, feels like 27℃, very humid. Mind the damp and ventilate indoors.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨 29℃，体感 33℃，湿度高。多云也闷热，注意防潮防暑。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is 29℃, feels like 33℃, high humidity. Muggy even with cloud, stay dry and cool.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳 29℃，体感 32℃，阴天湿度高。请注意防潮，保持心情舒畅。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is 29℃, feels like 32℃, cloudy with high humidity. Stay dry and cheerful!
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明小雨 19℃，体感 20℃，湿度很高。雨天路滑，注意安全哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has light rain, 19℃, feels like 20℃, very humid. Roads may be slippery, stay safe!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门 29℃，体感 31℃，湿度偏高。阴天也闷热，注意防潮解暑。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is 29℃, feels like 31℃, high humidity. Muggy with cloud, stay dry and cool.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗 31℃，体感 33℃，湿度大。注意防晒，及时补充水分。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny 31℃, feels like 33℃, high humidity. Use sunscreen and hydrate well.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗 32℃，体感 35℃，湿度不低。防晒补水，小心晒伤哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny 32℃, feels like 35℃, fairly humid. Sunscreen and hydrate, avoid sunburn!
